rule: A row with no label sorts last; otherwise by label, then by name. SQL: `order by label nulls last, name`. TypeScript: byLabel in entities.ts. internal/storage/label_order_test.go orders `rows` through the real ListTags query and web/src/lib/entities.test.ts orders them through byLabel; both assert `order`, so the two halves cannot drift apart. Labels are one case and ASCII on purpose: collation is not what this pins.
